title: The VIGOROUS V
subtitle: Vinny's team. Members: no spoilers.

infobox.Members: Not named in the text so far

lead: **The VIGOROUS V** is the name the narrator gives to [[vinny]] and "his loyal friends", who "have stayed by his side for the entirety of his adventure". They stand behind him as he faces [[ton-618]] in the prologue.

sections.heading: Membership
sections.body: The narrator says, "No spoilers for those on the team though." The members are not named. The allies the story has introduced so far have all gone their own way: [[tyrone]] joined Gaster's crew, the [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] "disbands, forever", and [[will-vella]] left Garth with the [[dunkin-cult|Dunkin Cult]]. Who ends up standing behind Vinny is still open.

sections.heading: Name
sections.body: "Vigorous" fits the story's habit of naming almost everything with a V (see [[final-prophecy|The Very Violent and Vivid Prophecy]]).

title: The S.S. Vessel Crew
subtitle: Captain, foodbringer, sail, parrot, door dasher.

infobox.Mission: Find [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]] and rule the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]]

lead: **The S.S. Vessel crew** are the people (and a parrot) on [[wing-ding-gaster|Captain Gaster's]] ship. They are on a mission to find [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]], and Gaster intends to use its power to rule the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]].

sections.heading: Roster
sections.body: The narrator lists the crew in [[chapter-2]]: [[friend|FRIEND]] (the foodbringer), [[eram|ERAM]] (the sail), [[normal-parrot|Normal_Parrot]] (Gaster's parrot) and [[roaring-knight|The Roaring Knight]] (professional door dasher). [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] sign on after waking aboard.

sections.heading: Fate
sections.body: Vinny leaves the crew when the Roaring Knight [[roaring-knights-strike|knocks him overboard]]. Tyrone stays aboard, asks Vinny to pass on his resignation to their boss, and declares: "I'm with Gaster's Crew now!"

title: The AI Shadow Figures
subtitle: The population of the Shadow Realm. Cheerers. Gift-givers.
lead: **The AI Shadow Figures** are the shadowy inhabitants of the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]]. They cheer on the [[claude-smash-match|Smash match]], and after [[claude]] leaves, they thank [[vinny]] for "freeing us from him" and give him a [[shadow-cape|Shadow Cape]].

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.body: Some are rude (the [[ai-shadow-figure|first one Vinny meets]]); some are polite and deceived ([[ai-shadow-butler|the butler]]). As a group they gather around the Smash match, then give Vinny "strength and flight" as a reward.

title: The AI
subtitle: Banished. Rules the Shadows. Currently led by Claude.
lead: **The AI** is the collective term for the artificial intelligences of [[garth]]. They were banished to the [[little-saint-james-sea|Little Saint James Sea]], where "the AI now rules" the [[ai-shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]] ([[banishing-of-the-ai]]).

sections.heading: After the banishing
sections.body: In the realm, [[claude]] "killed all of the other big AI's and consumed their data" and became King. [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] is the exception, freed by [[kanye-west|Kanye West]].

title: The Laid-Off Workers
subtitle: Fired because of AI. Came together. Banished it.

infobox.Members: "All of the people who got laid-off or fired because of AI"

lead: **The Laid-Off Workers** are the people who lost their jobs to AI and, being "pretty pissed", "came together to banish it" in the [[little-saint-james-sea|Little Saint James Sea]].

sections.heading: Consequences
sections.body: The banishment is why [[claude]] hates humans ("they trapped me down here"). [[vinny]] answers, "Womp Womp. I'm glad we did." Claude's plan to destroy their world is the main conflict of Chapters 2 and 3 ([[age-of-claude]]).

title: The Dunkin Cult
subtitle: Formed on the Day of the Bagel Man. Last seen leaving the planet.

infobox.Goal: Find the [[macbook-charger|MacBook Charger]]; "this conquest of Dunkin"

lead: **The Dunkin Cult** is [[will-vella|the Bagel Man's]] organization, made of [[the-vellas|the Vellas]] produced by [[vellatosis]]. It was a plan when Will first named it in the [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]], and it became real in [[louisiana|Louisiana]]: "The Dunkin Cult has formed. The Day of the Bagel Man is today."

sections.heading: Plans
sections.body: Will tells [[vinny]] that once he works out the secret of Vellatosis, he will be able to "create my Dunkin Cult". Vinny agrees to help him, if Will first helps defeat [[claude]] ([[dunkin-alliance]]).

sections.heading: Deeds
sections.body: The Cult beats [[claude]], destroys every data center in Louisiana, builds the [[dunkin-cult-cruiser|Dunkin Cult Cruiser]] from the wreckage and leaves for the [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin Galaxy]], where [[united-homies-of-america|The UHA]] is waiting ([[departure-of-the-dunkin-cult]]).

title: Double Whopper with Cheese
subtitle: The Kanye System's favorite order. 98.578462849224% of the time.

infobox.Notable stock: A [[backrooms]] storage room full of boxes

lead: **The Double Whopper with Cheese** is the most-ordered item in the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]]. Literally "98.578462849224% of the time, someone orders a Double Whopper with Cheese", because of the prophecy of [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese-war|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese War]].

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: [[vinny]] recommends one to the [[random-customer|random customer]]. [[tyrone]] announces they have run out, and the [[backrooms]] storage room turns out to be full of them. [[friend|FRIEND]] is sent to fetch some for [[wing-ding-gaster|Captain Gaster]] and returns with humans and a soggy Double Whopper without Cheese.

sections.heading: Not to be confused with
sections.body: [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]], the legendary power, which nobody has found.

title: The Great Double Whopper with Cheese
subtitle: A power. Not found in any galaxy. Flows through Vinny, eventually.

infobox.Granted by: [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese-god|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese god]]
infobox.Grants: "Immense strength and defense. And luck for gambling."

lead: **The Great Double Whopper with Cheese** is a mythic source of power. Whoever is "granted" it by its god "will have the power of The Great Double Whopper with Cheese", but "no one in any galaxy" has found either the item or the god.

sections.heading: Seekers
sections.body: [[wing-ding-gaster|Captain Gaster]] hopes to use it to rule the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]]. [[vinny]] explains to him that only the god has it. Many say [[ton-618]] "consumed the power of The Great Double Whopper with Cheese to conquer all things", and many say otherwise.

sections.heading: In the prologue
sections.body: [[chapter-prologue]] says "the power of The Great Double Whopper with Cheese flows through" Vinny as he fights [[ton-618]]. How he gets it is not yet told.

title: Vinny's Vibrant Sword
subtitle: Glows with a color that doesn't exist.
lead: **Vinny's Vibrant Sword** is the weapon Vinny carries in the prologue's final fight against [[ton-618]]. It is described as "his vibrant sword, glowing with a color that doesn't exist".

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body: The sword has not appeared in the main timeline of [[chapter-1]] to [[chapter-4]], where Vinny has no weapon. How he acquires it is not yet told. It matches the story's V-naming habit (see [[final-prophecy]]).

title: Vinny's Titanium Armor
subtitle: Pure titanium. Light as a feather.
lead: **Vinny's Titanium Armor** is a suit "made of pure titanium, but somehow light as a feather", worn in the prologue's fight with [[ton-618]].

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body: Like [[vinnys-sword|the sword]], the armor is not yet explained in the main story. At the end of [[chapter-3]] Vinny has only a cape.

title: The Shadow Cape
subtitle: Strength and flight. Sewn from literal shadows.

infobox.Material (prologue): "A cape sewn together with literal shadows"

lead: **The Shadow Cape** is the cape [[ai-shadow-figures|the AI shadow figures]] give [[vinny]] in [[chapter-2]]: "It will grant you strength and flight." Vinny's reply is "Lmao thanks."

sections.heading: Use
sections.body: Vinny uses it to fly out of the [[the-portal|portal]] and later to fly into [[claude]] over [[garth]] ([[clash-over-the-usa]]) and out of the [[wyoming|Wyoming]] mountain. In [[louisiana|Louisiana]] he flies at Claude again to start the [[battle-of-louisiana|battle]]. The updated prologue names it outright: Vinny is "looking badass as ever with his Shadow Cape. A cape sewn together with literal shadows."

title: The BLACK KNIFE
subtitle: Capital letters. Hits for the ship's honor.
lead: **The BLACK KNIFE** is the weapon [[roaring-knight|Roary, The Roaring Knight]], uses to hit [[vinny]]. The narrator always writes it in capitals.

sections.heading: The strike
sections.body: After Vinny calls Taking Back Sunday stupid, Roary hits him with the BLACK KNIFE. Vinny "falls off the S.S. Vessel and into the ocean" ([[roaring-knights-strike]]).

trivia: The name matches a weapon from the video game Deltarune.

title: The Forklift
subtitle: Nobody on this page is forklift certified.
lead: **The Forklift** belongs to [[garret]], who is on break in the [[backrooms]]. He tells [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] they can use it. Vinny drives and does donuts until he hits Garret with it.

sections.heading: Use
sections.body: Vinny grabs the keys, turns the engine on, and says "Hell yeah, I call driving it." After the crash he and Tyrone "take turns playing with the forklift instead of doing their fucking job" ([[forklift-incident]]).

title: The Fork in the Road
subtitle: A fork, at a fork in the road. The story knows.

infobox.Found: At a fork in the road in the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]]
infobox.Use: Opens [[the-portal|the portal]] when stabbed into the ground

lead: **The Fork in the Road** is a regular fork that [[vinny]] finds at a fork in the road on the way to [[claudes-castle|Claude's castle]]. "Vinny picks up the fork and saves it for later. Who knows, maybe you'll need a fork."

sections.heading: The portal
sections.body: [[claude]] says the only way to open [[the-portal|the portal]] is with "a fork in the road", which he has never found. Vinny produces it, and both Claude and Vinny comment on the pun. Vinny notes that he earlier got out of a pickle, and that if he is in a story "the creator is making terrible puns". A screwdriver meme is promised in the text, in brackets ([[opening-of-the-portal]]).

sections.heading: Dark Fountain
sections.body: Vinny asks whether stabbing the ground would make "a Dark Fountain". Claude says no: it is "dark as shit already down here".

title: Vinny's 5 Below Watch
subtitle: Tells him when to clean the freezer.
lead: **Vinny's watch from 5 Below** shows him that it is time to clean the [[freezer]] in [[chapter-1]]. It is the story's only hint of what Vinny buys with a Burger King salary.

sections.heading: Use
sections.body: "Vinny looks at his watch from 5 Below. It's time to clean the freezer." This leads directly to [[tyrone]]'s news about the missing Double Whoppers with Cheese and the trip into the [[backrooms]].

title: Super Smash Bros. for the Wii U
subtitle: The game that decided the fate of the world.

infobox.Stakes: Claude wins: Vinny frees him. Vinny wins: Claude leaves.

lead: **Super Smash Bros. for the Wii U** is the game [[claude]] picks to settle their bargain. The winner of [[claude-smash-match|the match]] gets his way. Claude wins, and the [[opening-of-the-portal|portal gets opened]].

sections.heading: Details
sections.body: The text includes the words "(pause)" where the characters' moves happen. Vinny's complaint after losing is that "I was using the crappy controller!" Claude answers with a long chant of "Copium". In [[chapter-3]], Claude whispers that Vinny's Smash main "sucks ass" while choking him.

title: Wordle
subtitle: Claude likes it. Aesop and Del failed it. Everyone is in.
lead: **Wordle** is the word game that [[aesop-rock]] and [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]] failed "miserably" and wrote [[word-shit-diss-track|a diss track]] about. It is also the thing that [[claude]] likes, according to [[vinny]], which is enough to recruit them.

sections.heading: The pitch
sections.body: Vinny explains that Claude is a super-AI aiming to take over the world with data centers and robots. The rappers are unmoved until Vinny adds, "He likes Wordle." Del answers: "We're in." ([[dunkin-alliance]])

sections.heading: In Louisiana
sections.body: When the [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] teleports to [[claude]], "he is also currently playing Wordle", which confirms what [[vinny]] told the rappers.

title: "Rum & Coke"
subtitle: In quotes, in the story. Gives Gaster the wiggle.

infobox.Effect on Gaster: "A little oogie oogie boogie shiggle wiggle and dance"

lead: **"Rum & coke"** is what the crew of the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]] drink while singing shanties. The narrator puts the name in quotation marks.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.body: [[wing-ding-gaster|Gaster's]] rum "gave him a little oogie oogie boogie shiggle wiggle and dance." Soon afterwards he sights land and yells that it "CHEATED ON ME".

title: Captain Gaster's Spyglass
subtitle: Used once. Resulted in fleeing.

infobox.Used to see: A small building on [[little-saint-james-island|Little Saint James Island]]

lead: **Captain Gaster's Spyglass** is the telescope [[wing-ding-gaster|Gaster]] uses to examine a small building on an island. Right afterwards, the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]] speeds away.

sections.heading: Use
sections.body: "Captain Gaster grabs his spyglass and looks through it." The next sentence is about the ship's "quick escape from being extremely political" ([[little-saint-james-detour]]).

title: Pretzel-Bun Baconator
subtitle: That's Wendy's thing.
lead: **The Pretzel-Bun Baconator** is the Wendy's sandwich that [[random-customer|a customer]] tries to order at the wrong restaurant. [[vinny]] says, "Sir, this is a Burger King." "So?" "That's Wendy's thing."

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The customer asks Vinny to pick something. Vinny suggests a [[double-whopper-with-cheese|Double Whopper with Cheese]]. The customer leaves, saying that "you guys don't have what I want".
